lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You don't even know me. Why are you being so kind?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Kindness doesn't require certainty. Only choice.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: And what do you see in my future?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text:
A storm you survive. Not because you are strong... but because
		someone will stand by your side.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: That is up to you.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text:
So, Frieda did work as a public seer... but instead of predicting
		destiny, she tried to give people courage.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: Not what i expected. Hmm, i should learn more about her

lines.speaker: Panicked Villager
lines.text: They'll kill them Frieda! Please, don't go near the soldiers!

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: I can't stay hidden while others die.

lines.speaker: Panicked Villager
lines.text: But you'll die too!

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text:
So be it! Maybe, just maybe, they'll listen if someone steps
		forward unarmed.

lines.speaker: Panicked Villager
lines.text: You're insane.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: I guess i am.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text:
This seems to be during a riot... when she stopped innocent
		women from being executed.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text:
She stepped in without hesitation. That kind of bravery isn't
		common.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: I need to understand who she really was.

lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: Lady Frieda, why do you tell us stories when you're tired?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Because you need them more than i need sleep.

lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: Do you think we'll ever be safe?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text:
Yes sweetheart. One day. And when that day comes... i want
		to build a home where fear doesn't reach you.

lines.speaker: Child
lines.text: Does a place like that actually exist?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: It will. I promise.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text:
So, she really cared for the children at the camp... enough to
		dream of giving them a future.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text:
This isn't the past of a cruel woman. There's more to Frieda than
		the rumours.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text:
Now that i know more about her, i should go look for her...
		she has to be here somewhere.
